observations: Photo 0: Black Canon DSLR body, 'Canon' and 'EOS 5D Mark III' badging visible on front, body cap on (no lens attached), a Canon retail box blurred in background.
Photo 1: Same camera shown from underside/back angle, 'EOS 5D' and 'Mark III' text visible on body, box visible behind it.
Photo 2: Camera held in a hand, front view again showing 'Canon', 'EOS 5D', 'Mark III' markings, body cap still on, no lens, no strap.
No photos show the LCD screen, viewfinder, top status display, memory card slot, battery compartment, or any powered-on state.
No lens, charger, battery, strap, or memory card visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Full frame DSLR camera for a photography business
claims.evidence: Model name confirms this body is normally full-frame, but no sensor photo or spec screen shown; functional claim for business use cannot be checked remotely.

claims.claim: Implied working condition (fit for business use)
claims.evidence: No photo shows camera powered on, no shutter actuation count, no screen, no test shot.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have sensor/shutter faults
risks.proof: A photo/video of the camera powered on with LCD showing menu and a test shutter count screenshot

risks.risk: No lens included, raising real cost to use
risks.proof: Photo showing a lens included in the sale

risks.risk: No battery, charger, or memory card shown
risks.proof: Photo of included battery, charger, and card

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy wear not visible under body cap
risks.proof: Photo of shutter count from camera menu or EOSInfo tool

risks.risk: Possible mismatched or fake box (box shown separately, not conclusive of authenticity)
risks.proof: Serial number on body matching box label, close-up photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, box disregarded

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, showing LCD menu and firmware version
Photo of shutter count via camera menu or third-party counter tool
Photo of included accessories: battery, charger, memory card, lens if any
Close-up of serial number on body matching the box label
Photo of sensor (front, lens off) for dust/scratch/fungus check
response.reason: Brand and model are clearly readable across all photos, but with no proof of power-on function, shutter count, or included accessories, the item must be priced as a body-only, untested unit at worst case.
